image_description: A grand, ornate Baroque-style high altar inside a church sanctuary. The structure features a massive gilded wooden retable with multiple tiers, columns, and religious statuary, topped by a sculptural group. In the foreground, a lower altar table is covered with a white cloth featuring gold embroidery, holding red cushions and lit candles. The background shows arched niches with paintings and architectural details of the church interior.
